description:
Thrust, torque and shaft power for one propeller, from its printed size.

    The simulator's Fast propeller model (version 2) on the propeller alone — no
    motor, no battery, no account. Give the size as it is printed: a 10x5 is
    `diameter_in=10`, `pitch_in=5`. `family` is the blade family: 'thin
    electric', 'sport', 'slow flyer', 'multirotor' or 'custom'; it sets the blade
    shape, the default camber and the chord ratio. `chord_ratio` (the chord at 75 %
    radius over the diameter) replaces the family's ratio and is required for
    'custom'; `camber_pct` replaces the family's camber.
name: estimate_propeller
title: Estimate a propeller
